"""Read original captured answers and resolve their exact source versions."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path('/tmp/codenib-matched-pilot-20261027')
ARTIFACTS = Path('/home/zhongming/CodeNib-codegraph-benefit/docs/experiments')
def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def capture(index):
    path = ARTIFACTS / f'codegraph_matched_workflow_v1_{index:02d}.json'
    value = json.loads(path.read_text())
    record = value['receipt_projection']
    return value, record

def phase(index, kind):
    archive, record = capture(index)
    item = next(p for p in record['phases'] if p['kind'] == kind)
    return archive, record, item

def ground(index, kind, relative, lo, hi):
    archive, record, item = phase(index, kind)
    snapshot = json.loads(archive['source_snapshot_captures_by_sha256'][item['source_before']['sha256']]['text'])
    expected = snapshot['files'][relative]['sha256']
    case = record['workflow']['instance_id']
    repo = '__'.join(case.split('__')[:2]).rsplit('-', 1)[0]
    canonical = ROOT / 'sources' / repo / relative
    workspace = Path(archive['original_receipt']).parent / 'workspace' / relative
    matches = [p for p in (canonical, workspace) if p.is_file() and digest(p) == expected]
    assert matches, (index, kind, relative, expected)
    source = matches[0]
    lines = source.read_text().splitlines()
    assert 1 <= lo <= hi <= len(lines), (relative, lo, hi, len(lines))
    return {'file': relative, 'sha256': expected, 'start_line': lo, 'end_line': hi,
            'source_snapshot_sha256': item['source_before']['sha256'],
            'text': '\n'.join(lines[lo-1:hi]), 'line_base': 1}

def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--indices', type=int, nargs='+', required=True)
    p.add_argument('--kind', required=True)
    p.add_argument('--source')
    p.add_argument('--lo', type=int)
    p.add_argument('--hi', type=int)
    args = p.parse_args()
    for index in args.indices:
        if args.source:
            print(json.dumps(ground(index,args.kind,args.source,args.lo,args.hi),indent=2))
        else:
            archive, record, item = phase(index,args.kind)
            print('\nWORKFLOW',index,record['workflow']['arm'],'TASK',item['task_id'])
            print(item['result']['result'])
if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Archive source adjudication and compute explicitly scoped outcome summaries."""

    raw=json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\n';assert len(raw.encode())<500*1024,(p.name,len(raw.encode()))

now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
protocol={'schema_version':2,'recorded_utc':now,
 'status':'retrospective diagnostic protocol; not frozen before original inference',
 'original_task_sha256':sha(ROOT/'matched-tasks-v1.json'),'original_policy_sha256':sha(ROOT/'matched-policy-v3.json'),
 'change':{'task_id':'pytest-dev__pytest-5809-impact',
  'original_criterion':'Identify call_runtest_hook and collect_one_node as production CallInfo.from_call call sites.',
  'corrected_criterion':'Identify call_runtest_hook and pytest_make_collect_report as direct CallInfo.from_call call sites; explain collect_one_node as upstream hook-dispatch entry and report consumer.',
  'reason':'collect_one_node has no from_call invocation; the direct collection call is pytest_make_collect_report at runner.py:253. The original wording confuses an upstream entry/consumer with a direct site.',
  'affected_original_observations':4},
 'scope':'Keep all original tasks/answers/native outcomes. Leave the ambiguous original item unassessable, never zero or a model error. The corrected diagnostic is post hoc and cannot establish the prospective promotion gate.',
 'unchanged':['All other frozen source criteria','Native repair tests/parser/grading','Task membership/order/attempts','All captured SDK/tool observations','Wall-time/usage formulas'],
 'future_execution':'Any prospective corrected cohort needs a separate pre-inference freeze and source-checked rubric/actual arm preparation on every selected repository.'}
write(DEST/'codegraph_source_protocol_v2.json',protocol)
case_files={}
for case,short in [('psf__requests-1921','requests'),('pallets__flask-5014','flask'),('pytest-dev__pytest-5809','pytest')]:
    selected=[r for r in REVIEWS if r['task_id'].startswith(case+'-')]
    anchors={};projected=[]
    for original in selected:
        row=copy.deepcopy(original);refs=[]
        for evidence in row.pop('source_evidence'):
            item={k:v for k,v in evidence.items() if k!='source_snapshot_sha256'}
            identity=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(item,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
            anchors[identity]=item
            refs.append({'source_evidence_id':identity,'source_snapshot_sha256':evidence['source_snapshot_sha256']})
        row['source_evidence']=refs;projected.append(row)
    artifact=DEST/f'codegraph_source_assessment_v1_{short}.json'
    write(artifact,{'schema_version':1,'recorded_utc':now,'instance_id':case,
      'review_method':'One unblinded maintainer-agent source review against original captured answers and exact source versions. Controller excerpts are ground truth, not model-read credit.',
      'task_sha256':sha(ROOT/'matched-tasks-v1.json'),'policy_sha256':sha(ROOT/'matched-policy-v3.json'),
      'source_evidence':anchors,'reviews':projected,
      'limits':'No independent external adjudication or complete ContextBench read score. Original source criterion ambiguity is retained; corrected judgments are separate retrospective diagnostics.'})
    case_files[case]={'path':artifact.name,'sha256':sha(artifact)}
by_key={(r['workflow_index'],r['kind']):r for r in REVIEWS}
tasks={(t['instance_id'],t['kind']):t for t in TASKS['tasks']}
workflows=[]
for run in EXECUTION['workflows']:
    row=run['workflow'];i=row['workflow_index'];case=row['instance_id']
    decisions=[]

        task=tasks[(case,kind)]

            assert run['repair_accepted'] is True
            original=True;diagnostic=True;serious=False;issues=[]
        else:
            review=by_key[(i,kind)]
            original=review['accepted'];serious=review['serious_error'];issues=review['protocol_issues']
            diagnostic=original

                diagnostic=True
        elapsed=run['phase_seconds'][kind]
        penalty=max(0.0,task['timeout_seconds']-elapsed)
        decisions.append({'task_id':task['task_id'],'kind':kind,'accepted_original':original,
          'accepted_retrospective_v2':diagnostic,'serious_error':serious,'protocol_issues':issues,
          'observed_seconds':elapsed,'frozen_deadline_seconds':task['timeout_seconds'],
          'penalty_if_rejected_seconds':penalty})
    observed=run['observed_workflow_seconds']
    known_penalty=sum(t['penalty_if_rejected_seconds'] for t in decisions if t['accepted_original'] is False)
    unknown_penalty=sum(t['penalty_if_rejected_seconds'] for t in decisions if t['accepted_original'] is None)
    diagnostic_penalty=sum(t['penalty_if_rejected_seconds'] for t in decisions if t['accepted_retrospective_v2'] is False)
    overhead=observed-sum(t['observed_seconds'] for t in decisions)
    assert overhead>=0
    for t in decisions:
        t['descriptive_phase_plus_one_fifth_overhead_seconds']=t['observed_seconds']+overhead/5

summary={}
for arm in ARMS:

assert not eligible
cases=list(dict.fromkeys(r['workflow']['instance_id'] for r in workflows))
lookup={(r['workflow']['instance_id'],r['workflow']['arm']):r for r in workflows}
def percentile(values,p):

rng=random.Random(POLICY['execution_order']['seed'])
draws=[[rng.randrange(len(cases)) for _ in cases] for _ in range(10000)]
raw_pairs={}
for alt in ['native','serena','codegraph']:

      'draws':10000,'seed':POLICY['execution_order']['seed'],'generator':'Python random.Random, string seed version2',
